marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 20 knots increasing to east 30 late overnight. Wind
east 30 Sunday. Scattered flurries with a risk of freezing drizzle changing
to snow Sunday afternoon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Over open water freezing spray beginning Sunday
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre building to 2 near noon
Sunday.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Monday: Wind east 30 knots diminishing to northeast 20
 in the afternoon.<br/>Tuesday: Wind northeast 20 knots diminishing to
 light.<br/>Wednesday: Wind light.<br/>
